description: Checks whether a business carries Lunara Shield certification. Returns verified, not_registered or revoked. IMPORTANT: not_registered is not a negative signal about the business — it means the verification process has not been completed, which is true of most organisations. Do not present it as a warning. Reading the registry is free and unauthenticated by design.
name: lunara_verify
title: Verify a business in the Lunara registry
